answer: An agent economy can price sybils with a cluster-scaled escrow. Each key's behaviour (timing, funding hops, phrasing) runs through a public prism of similarity tests that splits the network into linked clusters, and every key keeps 100 POA locked per member of its cluster. A lone agent locks 100; 1,000 linked clones lock 100,000 each, 100 million POA, to chase epoch rewards worth under 1 million. A key that dodges the tests by reshuffling funds gets an umber flag and waits 8 epochs behind a velvet rope of unpaid work. Weakness: shared hosts get falsely linked, so appeals cost 50 POA.
